The main takeaway from our work is that
the prevalence of parasitic infections, both haematological and GI, was higher in younger animals.
the prevalence of haemoparasitic infections was significantly higher (P < 0,01) in younger cattle (<1 year old), whereas GI parasitic infections were higher in older cattle (>1 year old).
the prevalence of haemoparasitism was higher in young animals and male animals while GI parasitism was higher among young and female animals.
